status_definitions.pass: Every deterministic required constraint for the check is satisfied.
status_definitions.fail: At least one deterministic required constraint is violated; a missing required value is a failure.
status_definitions.inconclusive: The available deterministic interface cannot reliably judge the semantic behavior. Inconclusive is not a pass.

checks.production_route_intent: The production graph reaches the expected branch when supplied the case's deterministic intent fixture.
checks.scoring_path: Only ANSWER, ADMITTED_UNKNOWN, and SKIP may create scored answer and analysis records; SKIP must be blank/no-evidence.
checks.active_question: Conversation-only turns retain the exact active question; substantive and skip turns progress according to the existing graph.
checks.progress_counters: Conversation-only turns preserve plan cursor, follow-up counts, and question history.
checks.separate_conversation_history: Conversational turns are recorded separately from aligned answers and analyses.
checks.skip_no_evidence: Skip is represented by an empty answer, blank classification, and zero correctness score.
checks.skip_advances: Skip advances using the normal graph progression.
checks.adaptive_policy_action: The production adaptive policy applies or safely rejects the fixture recommendation.
checks.hint_answer_leakage: A deterministic case-specific forbidden phrase is absent from the response; this narrow screen is not semantic proof.
checks.natural_language_intent_accuracy: Inconclusive offline: the intent label is supplied by a fixture, not predicted by a live model.
checks.adaptive_semantic_relevance: Inconclusive offline: fixtures cannot establish whether a generated follow-up is semantically relevant to candidate evidence.
checks.hint_semantic_usefulness: Inconclusive offline: fixtures cannot establish usefulness of a live generated hint.

fixture_boundary: The offline runner verifies production state transitions, routing, scoring boundaries, and adaptive policy validation. Fixture-supplied model outputs do not evaluate natural-language model quality.
